## Sources of Data - By Subject

To expand your search, you can visit the following pages:

*   [Research Guides This link opens in a new window](https://dal.ca.libguides.com/) Search for a research guide for your discipline and see if your librarian has put together a page or section sharing data, datasets, or statistics.   
*   [Statistics Canada's subject page This link opens in a new window](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/subjects?MM=1) Pick a subject to navigate to a specialized portal or hub.   
*   [Statistics Canada's Survey by Subjects This link opens in a new window](https://www23.statcan.gc.ca/imdb-bmdi/pub/indexth-eng.htm?MM) Pick a subject to find a list of Statistics Canada surveys strongly linked with the subject.   
*   [Canadian Census Page This link opens in a new window](https://dal.ca.libguides.com/data/census) Explore the Canadian Census for data about population, age, sex, dwellings, families, marital status, language, immigration and ethnocultural diversity, aboriginal peoples, education and labour, mobility and migration, language of work, income and housing.   
*   [DLI and RDC Page This link opens in a new window](https://dal.ca.libguides.com/data/dli) Learn about the DLI and RDC programs to find and access Canadian microdata.   

#### **Business and Industry**

*   [Canadian Cluster Data This link opens in a new window](https://www.ic.gc.ca/app/scr/cmb-dgcm/poi-pi/mp.html?tpcId=341&lang=eng) Interesting data on the contribution of clusters of traded industries to regional and national economies.   
*   [Canadian Industry Statistics This link opens in a new window](https://www.ic.gc.ca/app/scr/app/cis/search-recherche?lang=eng) Analyses industry data on many economic indicators using the most recent data from Statistics Canada   
*   [SME Benchmarking Tool This link opens in a new window](https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/financial-performance-data/en) From Industry Canada - View financial performance data by industry.   
*   [Industry Canada - Trade Data Online This link opens in a new window](http://www.ic.gc.ca/eic/site/tdo-dcd.nsf/eng/Home) Canada and/or provinces, and/or trading partners data for imports, exports, domestic market, manufacturing shipments, trade balance.   

#### **Economy and Finances**

*   [Bank of Canada This link opens in a new window](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/) Interest and exchange rates, price indices, monetary indicators and statistics.   
*   [Canadian Metropolitan Outlook - Halifax This link opens in a new window](https://ezproxy.library.dal.ca/login?Url=http://www.conferenceboard.ca/e-library/abstract.aspx?did=7108) Overview and forecasts for the Halifax economy from the Conference Board of Canada.   
*   [RBC Economics Research This link opens in a new window](http://www.rbc.com/economics/index.html) Provides analysis and forecasts of the Canadian economy and financial markets. Also included are the indicators for the United States and key international markets.   
*   [Finances of the Nation This link opens in a new window](https://www.ctf.ca/EN/EN/Publications/Finances_of_the_Nation_Online.aspx) From the Canadian Tax Foundation.   

#### **First Nations**

*   [Indigenous and Northern Affairs Canada - Research and Statistics This link opens in a new window](https://www.sac-isc.gc.ca/eng/1100100016570/1604594851787) Includes demographic projections, fact sheets, population by gender and residence.   
*   [First Nation Profiles This link opens in a new window](https://fnp-ppn.aadnc-aandc.gc.ca/fnp/Main/index.aspx?lang=eng) From Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada.   
*   [Focus on Geography Series 2021 This link opens in a new window](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/as-sa/fogs-spg/index.cfm?Lang=E) Data on Indigenous Peoples, Immigration and Ethnocultural Diversity, Education, Labour, Income and Housing at different levels of geography.   
*   [Indigenous Statistics Portal This link opens in a new window](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/subjects-start/indigenous_peoples) Stat Can subject portal.   

#### **Health**

*   [COVID-19: A Data Perspective This link opens in a new window](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/covid19) Statistics Canada data portal for COVID data. Explore the dashboards under "Highlights" or click on "All COVID-19 releases" for a searchable list of data tables, data publications, etc.   
*   [Canadian Alcohol and Drug Use Monitoring Survey (CADUMS) This link opens in a new window](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/health-concerns/drug-prevention-treatment/drug-alcohol-use-statistics.html) Summaries available from Health Canada, microdata available in SDA (see Canadian Datasets).   
*   [Health Statistics LibGuide This link opens in a new window](https://dal.ca.libguides.com/healthstats) For a comprehensive resource outlining the best places to find health statistics, see our LibGuide for that topic.   
*   [Statistics Canada - Health Statistics This link opens in a new window](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/subjects/Health) Portal of Statistics Canada Health Statistics.   
*   [Statistics Canada - Health Profiles - 2013 This link opens in a new window](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/health-sante/82-228/index.cfm?Lang=E&sid=a&lid=1) Use the "Browse" pull-down menu to select Nova Scotia. Explore the Health Indicators instead of the Health Profiles for more recent health data.   
*   [Statistics Canada - Health Regions This link opens in a new window](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/catalogue/82-402-X) Reference maps (PDF) and boundary files (geospatial software) for health regions by province. Click on the most recent entry, select "Table of Contents".   
*   [Statistics Canada - Health Trends This link opens in a new window](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/catalogue/82-213-X) Comparable time-series data for a range of health indicators from a number of sources including the Canadian Community Health Survey, Vital Statistics, and Canadian Cancer Registry (last released in 2014).   
*   [Canadian Biomonitoring Dashboard This link opens in a new window](https://health-infobase.canada.ca/biomonitoring/) "Levels of environmental chemicals in the Canadian population from the Canadian Health Measures Survey"   
*   [Physical Activity, Sedentary Behaviour and Sleep Indicators This link opens in a new window](https://health-infobase.canada.ca/pass/data-tool.html?ind=1) "A snapshot of daily movement behaviours among Canadian children, youth and adults, using the Physical Activity, Sedentary Behaviour, and Sleep (PASS) Indicators."   

#### **Housing, Income, and Poverty**

*   [CMHC Data Tables This link opens in a new window](https://www.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/professionals/housing-markets-data-and-research) These tables provide an overview of housing conditions and trends in Canada and in each province and Census Metropolitan Area, including housing construction, prices, and sales; rental market trends; mortgage lending; and housing stock.   
*   [Income Statistics This link opens in a new window](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/programs/about-canada-revenue-agency-cra/income-statistics-gst-hst-statistics.html) Annual data from the Canada Revenue Agency, including by Census Subdivision.  [more...](javascript:void(0);)[less...](javascript:void(0);)  The annual Income Statistics reports use tables of data to create a profile of Canadian taxpayers.  
  
 Final Statistics - Sample Data  
 Detailed profiles of Canadian taxfilers based on a stratified random sample of individual tax returns  
  
 Interim Statistics - Universe Data  
 Preliminary statistics based on the universe of all returns filed and processed during a given tax year. This usually represents about 97% of all returns filed   
*   [Focus on Geography Series 2021 This link opens in a new window](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/as-sa/fogs-spg/index.cfm?Lang=E) Data on Indigenous Peoples, Immigration and Ethnocultural Diversity, Education, Labour, Income and Housing at different levels of geography.   
*   [Royal LePage House Price Survey This link opens in a new window](https://www.royallepage.ca/en/realestate/info-and-advice/market-reports-and-surveys/) Comprehensive reports from Halifax to the national market. Links to data tables are provided at the end of many releases.   

#### **Immigration**

*   [Citizenship and Immigration Statistics This link opens in a new window](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/corporate/reports-statistics/statistics-open-data.html) Contains annual statistical information, quarterly administrative data releases, and a 1966 to 1996 statistics archive.   
*   [Focus on Geography Series 2021 This link opens in a new window](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/as-sa/fogs-spg/index.cfm?Lang=E) Data on Indigenous Peoples, Immigration and Ethnocultural Diversity, Education, Labour, Income and Housing at different levels of geography.   

#### **Politics, Voting and Opinion Polls**

*   [Canadian Opinion Research Archive (CORA) This link opens in a new window](https://odesi.ca/en) As of December 2017, you can download the microdata of many Canadian opinion polls in Odesi. Select "CORA" or "Public Opinion Polls" under "Collections".   
*   [Canadian Opinion Research Archive (CORA) - Canadian Election Studies and Other Polls This link opens in a new window](https://www.queensu.ca/cora/data-holdings) Why people vote the way they do ... what does and does not change during the campaign and from one election to another.   
*   [Ipsos Canada This link opens in a new window](https://dataverse.scholarsportal.info/dataverse/Ipsos) Free access to Canadian opinion polls about voting intentions and some other topics.   
*   [Odesi This link opens in a new window](https://odesi.ca/en) Dalhousie does not subscribe to Odesi, but much of its content is publicly available. It is possible to both download files and do some online data tabulations. You can use Odesi to do a variable search for Statistics Canada microdata and to download many PUMFs. Microdata from many CORA opinion polls are also available for download in Odesi. There is some added value compared to the official PUMFs distributed on Statistics Canada's website.   

#### **Transportation**

*   [North American Transportation Statistics database This link opens in a new window](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/north-american-transportation-statistics-database) Includes Canada, USA, Mexico.   
*   [Urban Transportation Indicators 2016 This link opens in a new window](https://www.tac-atc.ca/en/knowledge-centre/technical-resources-search/publications/rpt-utip5-e/) Includes indicators for several Canadian cities including Halifax.   

#### **Other**

*   [Atlantic Data Stream This link opens in a new window](https://atlanticdatastream.ca/#/) Gives access to "full water quality datasets collected by 23 monitoring groups from Newfoundland and Labrador, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island and Nova Scotia."   
*   [Canadian Astronomy Data Centre This link opens in a new window](https://www.cadc-ccda.hia-iha.nrc-cnrc.gc.ca/en/) "The CADC's data collection, along with its world-leading cloud infrastructure for astronomy, provides a unique resource for data-intensive astrophysical research."   
*   [Data on Racialized Populations This link opens in a new window](https://learn.scholarsportal.info/featured/data-on-racialized-populations/) Guide providing a "starting point for researchers investigating topics about anti-racism and the impact of racism."   
*   [National Climate Data and Information Archive This link opens in a new window](https://climate.weather.gc.ca/) "Access historical weather, climate data, and related information for numerous locations across Canada. "   
*   [National Pollutant Release Inventory (NPRI) This link opens in a new window](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/environment/pollution-waste-management/national-pollutant-release-inventory.html) Find out about pollutant releases and transfers by postal code.   
*   [Women in Canada: A Gender-based Statistical Report: 2015 This link opens in a new window](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/pub/89-503-x/89-503-x2015001-eng.htm) Comprehensive portrait of women in Canada today including their demographic profile, family status, health, educational attainment, labour force characteristics, and income levels, as well as their involvement in criminal activity as both perpetrators and victims.   
*   [Urban Data Centre This link opens in a new window](https://data.urbandatacentre.ca/) "The mission of the Canadian Urban Data Catalogue (CUDC) is to provide awareness of the vast array of urban and non-urban Canadian data by providing an open catalogue of Canadian datasets."
